contract_answer.question: Does the NA-E006 configuration (NaFadeNet + gated fade extrapolation) improve on parent NaFadeNet on paper split 2024, completing the three-split comparison?
contract_answer.conclusion: Independently recomputed from all 600 saved predictions: selected epoch-23 MAPE 0.155002, Acc@15 0.525, and RMSE 30.567 versus NA-E005 at 0.177199, 0.470, and 33.997. Minimum MAPE was 0.154088 at epoch 19, but epoch 23 was correctly selected within the 0.005 tolerance for higher Acc@15. Across NA-E006/007/008, MAPE is 0.147394 +/- 0.038881, Acc@15 is 0.553889 +/- 0.120949, and RMSE is 35.638 +/- 14.794; MAPE improves over NaFadeNet by 0.021557.

main_symptom: The split-2024 confirmation improves every prefix band, but 26-50 remains weakest at 0.1843 MAPE; cells 6-2-30 and 7-1-23 remain largest at 0.2567 and 0.2302.

contradicting_evidence: Cell 7-1-23 slightly regresses from 0.22964 to 0.23017 MAPE.
Mean signed relative error changes from 0.00229 to 0.00396, so bias correction is not this split's gain source.
causes.interpretation: The extrapolation path improves all five prefix bands by 0.0141 to 0.0335 MAPE, reduces mild over-dispersion from 1.1537 to 1.1228, raises prediction-target correlation from 0.7040 to 0.7520, and most improves 5-2-38 (0.23137 to 0.16753).
missing_evidence: Saved per-sample gate outputs by prefix band.

contradicting_evidence: The gate is HEALTHY: median grad/parameter ratio 0.002075, median update ratio 0.0001063, and no non-finite gradients.
This 360-step run moves the output layer farther than NA-E006/007, so flatness cannot be quantified without direct gate outputs.
causes.interpretation: After 360 steps, calibration remains close to initialization (ext_scale=2.008075, ext_shift=-3.604699) and the gate output layer remains modest (bias=-1.986225; maximum absolute weight=0.015917). This supports a targeted learning-speed test but not a claim that the gate is exactly flat on this split.
missing_evidence: A matched effective-step reparameterization of only gate/calibration.
Direct gate-output summaries on validation samples.

contradicting_evidence: Selected MAPE is only 0.000914 above the minimum and Acc@15 improves from 0.521667 to 0.525.
Epoch-24 MAPE is only 0.001449 above the minimum, so there is no large late collapse.
causes.interpretation: The checkpoint rule operated as specified: epoch 19 supplies minimum MAPE 0.154088, while eligible epoch 23 supplies higher Acc@15 and selected MAPE 0.155002. Train loss continues from 0.010097 at epoch 19 to 0.009440 at epoch 24 without material validation collapse.
missing_evidence: A fixed-g matched control under the same checkpoint rule.
